name: close_range
synopsis: int close_range(unsigned int first, unsigned int last, int flags);
description: The close_range() system call closes all open file descriptors in the range from 'first' to 'last' inclusive. It can also set flags to modify behavior, such as setting close-on-exec or unsharing descriptors. Errors during closure of individual descriptors are ignored.

parameters.name: first
parameters.description: The first file descriptor to close (inclusive).

parameters.name: last
parameters.description: The last file descriptor to close (inclusive).

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: A bitmask of flags, such as CLOSE_RANGE_CLOEXEC or CLOSE_RANGE_UNSHARE, to modify the behavior.

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set

errors.description: Invalid flags specified, or first is greater than last.
The number of open file descriptors exceeds the limit specified in /proc/sys/fs/nr_open, particularly with CLOSE_RANGE_UNSHARE.
Insufficient kernel memory was available, especially with CLOSE_RANGE_UNSHARE.

examples: /* Full program example iterates through files and uses close_range */
